actions.title: Search the Composio catalog
actions.description: Find tools across Composio's connected toolkits by describing the task in plain language. Returns matching tool names and what each does. Use this first — Composio exposes thousands of tools and their exact names are not guessable. Does not run anything.

use_case.description: What the user is trying to do, in their own words.

toolkits.description: Optional slugs to narrow the search, e.g. GITHUB, GMAIL.

actions.title: Read a Composio tool's schema
actions.description: Return the input schema for named Composio tools, so a caller knows what arguments to send. Read-only; pair it with composio.tools.search, which supplies the names.

actions.title: List Composio account connections
actions.description: Show which third-party accounts are connected to this Composio user, and their status. Read-only: it reports what exists, it does not authorize anything new.

actions.title: Execute a Composio tool
actions.description: Run one or more tools from Composio's catalog against the user's connected accounts. This is the action that actually does things — send an email, open an issue, write a row. Get the exact tool name and arguments from composio.tools.search and composio.tools.schema first; a guessed name fails, and a guessed argument can act on the wrong record.
